A [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] '''refugee''' resided in [[Mek-Sha]] in [[3627 BBY]]. She was captured by the [[Slaver/Legends|slavers]] [[The Brothers]] but got rescued by a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]-aligned individual.<ref name="Brotherhoood Emancipation">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=heroic|Brotherhoood Emancipation|[[Mek-Sha]]}}</ref> Taking residence on [[Junker's Junction]], she further requested the aid of the Republic agent to strike against the slavers.<ref name="Breaking the Yoke" />
